principles.model: Run the Kowork checkpoint locally; no external AI inference API.
principles.internet: Direct browsing of public HTTPS sites through a real browser engine. Access is subject to site availability, login, robots, terms, DRM, and human verification.
principles.permissions: Request Android permissions only when a user enables the feature that needs them; no hidden background surveillance.
principles.user_control: Show the current browser URL, permission state, active workspace, and actions before destructive or external side effects.
principles.truthfulness: A feature is not considered available until its runtime is installed, permission granted, and integration tests pass.

limits: no bypassing paywalls or access controls
download/upload and destructive actions require explicit confirmation
not all internet pages may be copied into training data
knowledge collection is separate from live browsing

supports: notifications only if user enables them
microphone only after explicit permission and visible recording state
limits: Android sandbox and OS permission model remain enforced
needs a Linux runtime or remote host; not provided merely by the Android app

supports: Windows desktop apps and Windows-only tools through a licensed Windows VM or user-owned Windows host
limits: Windows cannot be silently bundled as a full OS inside an Android APK; requires valid licensing and hardware or remote compute

supports: open Roblox Creator documentation in browser
connect to Roblox Studio only through a user-controlled Windows desktop/VM integration
limits: Roblox Studio is a desktop application; browser access alone does not run Studio and does not grant Roblox account access

supports: shared project files through an explicit workspace sync service
limits: this is an orchestrated set of environments, not Android, Windows and Linux merged into one installable operating system
